## Giant viruses — Nucleocytoviricota

224 genomes across 15 families, targeted with eight marker genes.

![](analysis_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png)

![](analysis_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png)

::: {.callout-important}
Missing values do not automatically indicate true biological absence. They may reflect incomplete genome sequences, marker divergence, ORF prediction limits, or filtering thresholds. See [About → Notes and limitations](about.qmd#notes-and-limitations).
:::

### Phylogenetic diversity

A phylogenetic tree was generated from a concatenated alignment of the eight giant-virus marker genes: individual marker alignments produced with MAFFT, trimmed with TrimAl, concatenated, and used for tree inference with IQ-TREE. Only viruses with at least five retained markers were included.

![VirMarkDB phylogenetic tree based on concatenated marker-gene alignments](data/tree_five_markers.png)

## Phages — Uroviricota (g23)

:::
